description: Create a new user or update default new user information.

option.name: --add-subids-for-system
tip: Add entries to sub[ud]id even when adding a system user.

option.name: --badname
tip: Do not check for bad names. (deprecated)

option.name: --base-dir
tip: Base directory for the home directory of the new account.

option.name: --btrfs-subvolume-home
tip: Use BTRFS subvolume for home directory.

option.name: --comment
tip: GECOS field of the new account.

option.name: --create-home
tip: Create the user's home directory.

option.name: --defaults
tip: Print or change default useradd configuration.

option.name: --expiredate
tip: Expiration date of the new account.

option.name: --gid
tip: Name or ID of the primary group of the new account.

option.name: --groups
tip: List of supplementary groups of the new account.

option.name: --help
tip: Display help message and exit.

option.name: --home-dir
tip: Home directory of the new account.

option.name: --inactive
tip: Password inactivity period of the new account.

option.name: --key
tip: Override /etc/login.defs defaults.

option.name: --no-create-home
tip: Do not create the user's home directory.

option.name: --no-log-init
tip: Do not add the user to the lastlog and faillog databases.

option.name: --no-user-group
tip: Do not create a group with the same name as the user.

option.name: --non-unique
tip: Allow to create users with duplicate (non-unique) UID.

option.name: --password
tip: Encrypted password of the new account.

option.name: --prefix
tip: Apply changes to configuration files under the root filesystem found under PREFIX_DIR.
This option does not chroot and is intended for preparing a cross-compilation target.

option.name: --root
tip: Apply changes in the CHROOT_DIR directory and use the configuration files from the CHROOT_DIR directory.
Only absolute paths are supported.

option.name: --selinux-range
tip: Use a specific MLS range for the SELinux user mapping.

option.name: --selinux-user
tip: Use a specific SEUSER for the SELinux user mapping.

option.name: --shell
tip: Login shell of the new account.

option.name: --skel
tip: Use this alternative skeleton directory.

option.name: --system
tip: Create a system account.

option.name: --uid
tip: User ID of the new account.

option.name: --user-group
tip: Create a group with the same name as the user.
